scope: Trial-only aggregate findings plus axis/option labels and order, minimal candidate catalogue, and canonical hashes/URL for full current website source; full case-specific website synthesis is not redistributed.
excluded_fields: Ranking evidence, uncertainty, inference, clinical limitations and source narratives
canonical_hash_recipe: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(section,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False), without terminal newline.
